title: Objective Auto-run controls UI hardening — fail-closed canonical controls, exact-body retry, identity validation
description: Owner-facing Auto-run controls on /app/objectives/:id — canonical GET /auto-policy polled 5s while visible (abort-per-tick, no stale overwrite). R1: eligibility-only driver readiness (READY/NOT READY + driver_missing verbatim), fail-closed controls gated on polCtl=canonical-verified status only, exact-body retry via pendingOps signature store, canonical identity validation (IDENTITY_MISMATCH), cockpit snapshot labeled non-authoritative, 5s poll paused on hidden tab. R2: F1 pending Configure restore — pendingCfg tracks the unresolved configure op; reopening the dialog restores the originally submitted limits/version/key (never resets to defaults); a genuinely different confirmed body supersedes the stored op as an explicit new operation; canonical version drift is surfaced in-dialog, never silently dropped; F2 open-dialog lock — ConfirmDialog.confirmDisabled + in-runPolicy canonical/context guard lock any already-open policy confirmation while status is unavailable/unverified (zero POST, force-click included), retry resumes the identical op when canonical recovers. Adversarial e2e: GET 403/500 zero-POST, driver_ready≠running, configure-edit exact replay (limits 9 preserved, not defaults), POST-committed-response-lost replay with no duplicate transition (policy_version stays 2), CAS→new-op-key, identity mismatch, hidden-tab pause/resume, open-dialog lock/recover. Zero backend/scheduler/schema changes. e2e objectives.spec.ts 33/33 pass; tsc+vite build clean; known baseline: P15.9-B5.4 'policy HALT' double-click flake (passes isolated).
